verdict.rationale: Warp's homepage says a built-in 'Warp Agent' takes on onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits, asks the user when a decision is theirs, and records every action it takes. That is a first-party agent users can delegate HR/payroll tasks to, but it rests on a single marketing line with no product docs. Missing for 10: documentation of how users assign tasks to the agent, its scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
